title: Adding and Subtracting Tens Word Problems
intro: Teach addition and subtraction of tens by counting groups of ten.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Build each quantity with tens rods. Match adding or removing rods to the action in the story.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Start: 50 counters
5 tens
Give away 20 counters
3 tens remain

5 tens − 2 tens = 3 tens
50 − 20 = 30 counters

Each complete rod stands for ten counters. Cross out two whole rods, not two small sections.

Ask your student

If three rods remain, how many individual counters is that?

If your student needs help

If the student answers three instead of thirty, ask them to name the unit each rod represents.
